inline_text:
## Outcome

Evidence that Agent Resource Discovery (ARD) lifecycle telemetry can be emitted,
correlated with skill execution, and exported through a standard OTLP pipeline.

This issue tracks WG review and coordination. Implementation remains in:
https://github.com/91pavan/ard-lifecycle-instrumentation (for now)

## Why

The ARD proposal needs implementation evidence showing that discovery,
provenance, governance, trust evaluation, and admission decisions can be
observed across agent and gateway boundaries.

The PoC also tests whether an admitted skill can be correlated with its
subsequent activation and execution without requiring a vendor-specific
observability backend.

## Work

- Record the validated Agent Gateway and ARD policy instrumentation.
- Instrument skill activation and execution in Goose.
- Correlate ARD decisions with skill activation using W3C Trace Context.
- Export reusable OTLP JSON fixtures.
- Validate the ARD pipeline with a second agent.
- Document semantic, instrumentation, and protocol gaps.
- Present findings to the WG and identify appropriate upstream contributions.

## Acceptance Criteria

Done when:

- All five ARD stages are exported through OTLP:
  discovery, provenance, governance, trust, and decision.
- Allowed and quarantined capabilities produce the expected telemetry.
- An ARD admission decision can be correlated with subsequent skill activation
  and execution.
- A quarantined capability has an ARD record without fictional execution spans.
- Reproducible session fixtures and validation instructions are published.
- Cross-agent behavior is tested or its limitations are documented.
- Findings and open questions are reviewed by the WG.
- Follow-up contributions or issues are linked for the relevant standards and
  projects.

## Current Status

- Phase 0: validated
- Phase 1: validated
- Phase 2: Goose skill lifecycle instrumentation pending
- Phase 3: correlation and fixture validation pending
- Phase 4: second-agent validation pending

## Tracking

- Workstream: ARD lifecycle and skills observability
- Owner: LLM primitives and Protocol Observability FG
- Status: implementation in progress
- Next step: implement and validate Goose skill activation and execution spans
- Depends on: none

## Boundaries

- This issue does not make the experimental `ard.*` or `gen_ai.skill.*`
  namespaces an adopted WG standard.
- The external repository owns implementation-level tasks and defects.
- This issue tracks WG visibility, review, evidence, and upstream disposition.
- This work is separate from the Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan,
  although findings may inform it.
